purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: If exact/equivalent numerical-topology recovery becomes causally exhausted, switch to learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route.

L1_PHASE.goal: Host numerical recovery: reduce full47 max_abs from current 0.0004115104675292969 to <=0.0003 while preserving semantic gates and protected-data boundaries.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: Numerical gate passes -> stop search and enter host structural qualification.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: After the closed tree mechanism, allow by default at most one genuinely distinct evidence-backed exact/equivalent family; if it also fails material progress, activate L0 contingency.

L2_MECHANISM.name: POST_TREE_FRESH_CAUSAL_RELOCALIZATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Residual taps prove the final-sensitive direction is already present at block0 residual Add3. The remaining question is whether it originates in embed/stem computation or is first injected inside block0.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Diagnostic phase only. Do not create candidates until stem vs block0 intrinsic source is resolved. After localization, at most one causally distinct exact/equivalent family is permitted by default.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Identify the earliest stem/block0 internal boundary that introduces a materially final-sensitive QNN-vs-ORT residual and distinguish propagated input error from intrinsic backend error.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: If the residual is already present at the first embed Conv output and no exact/equivalent high-leverage mechanism is credible, activate the learned-residual/wider-student/qualified-surrogate contingency rather than micro-tuning.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Does the dangerous warm18 direction originate in embed Conv/stem normalization or inside block0, and at which internal block0 operator boundary does it become final-sensitive?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Expose read-only outputs for embed Conv, stem LN, block0 input, DWConv, block0 LN, PW1/pre-activation, activation, PW2, gamma and Add3. Reuse the same frozen six diagnostic inputs and untapped current-best reference. Require all 12 final outputs bit-exact before interpreting taps. Then compare candidate-own QNN2.44 vs ORT1.27 and use clean downstream propagation/intrinsic closure only; no candidate selection.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Identify the earliest internal boundary whose intrinsic backend error accounts for the final-sensitive direction. If embed Conv already carries it, stop backward localization at the first model operation because features are identical frozen input bytes.

L4_ACTION.action: Convert/compile and execute the stem+block0 tapped current-best graph once on the frozen six inputs, reuse the untapped reference, require final bit-exact observer PASS, then perform internal QNN-vs-ORT scoring and clean propagation to Add3/final.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: Add3 already carries enough residual direction to explain the final failure, so the next causal step is to distinguish embed/stem from block0 intrinsic source rather than modify later blocks.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and perform causal re-localization.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not spend a family on micro-tuning; justify a mechanism with plausible leverage or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_one_additional_distinct_exact_fami: Return to L1/L0 and activate learned/student/surrogate contingency unless new causal evidence materially changes the model.

preflight_questions: What parent task does this action advance?
What causal mechanism makes it capable of material progress toward the remaining gate gap?
What result closes this experiment or mechanism?
What protected data must remain unseen?
If it fails, which parent level do we return to instead of adding variants?
